richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Khora, Ghaziabad

c: Khora, on the Ghaziabad side of the Noida border, is a dense colony of narrow lanes, and delivery is the first thing to plan for an outdoor gym here. A truck cannot always reach the park gate. FunPlay Systems supplies Fun Fitness outdoor gym equipment to RWA parks, schools and community grounds in Khora, made at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,120 km away.

Tell us how close a vehicle can get to your site and how wide the lane is at its narrowest point. We plan the delivery around that before dispatch. Our installation team or a dealer in north India then fixes each machine, grouted or self-standing, as per the approved layout. Send us photos of the lane and the park, and we will plan the layout and delivery together.

items.q: Can you deliver to a park in a narrow lane?
items.a: Tell us how close a vehicle can get and how wide the lane is. We plan the delivery and the choice of machines around that before anything is dispatched from Vasai.

items.q: Which machines suit a very small park?
items.a: Single-post machines such as the Standing Twister Single, Shoulder Twirl and Leg Lift Post. They need little space and cover the waist, shoulders and legs.

items.q: Do you supply outdoor gyms in Ghaziabad?
items.a: Yes. We dispatch from our factory in Vasai by road and install through our own team or a dealer in north India.
